summary: Rasmussen develops arbitrary limits into qualified perfection; Schmid’s holistic, axiological, symmetry, and necessity objections leave the God-like conclusion substantially underdetermined.

pro.text: maximal power, maximal persistence, persistence in existence across all times
pro.context: Rasmussen uses this formulation while identifying the attributes supported by his least-arbitrary account of fundamental reality.

con.text: naturalism's inclusion of fundamental limits is a mark against the theory
con.context: Schmid grants a local theoretical disadvantage while denying that this consideration independently establishes theism.

pro-reduce-foundational-arbitrariness.words: A satisfactory theory of fundamental reality should minimize arbitrariness, because unexplained foundational limits provide reason to doubt that the proposed base is genuinely fundamental.
pro-reduce-foundational-arbitrariness.critique: Strongest feature: The move establishes a comprehensible explanatory project, explicitly beginning with an unspecified base reality and proposing reduction of foundational arbitrariness without pretending that the strategy deductively settles its destination. Principal limitation: The operative meaning of arbitrariness remains insufficiently discriminating, and the normative force of saying a theory should reduce it is not fully separated from a methodological preference for deeper explanation. Live burden: The argument must specify which differences between possible limits are genuinely irrelevant and explain why an unexplained parameter counts against fundamentality rather than merely marking an unavoidable explanatory stopping point. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects excellent motion relevance, recoverable structure, and appropriately qualified ambition, moderated by underdeveloped terminology and incomplete independent warrant for the governing explanatory demand.

pro-foundation-to-relevant-perfection.words: If a foundation has some greatness and its limits receive explanations, its greatness is not arbitrarily limited, supporting perfection in a relevant but qualified sense.
pro-foundation-to-relevant-perfection.critique: Strongest feature: The conditional progression is transparent and directly supplies the motion-level bridge from some foundational greatness, through removal of arbitrary limitation, to a carefully qualified conception of relevant perfection. Principal limitation: The phrase in some sense perfect leaves the kind, dimensions, and degree of perfection unsettled, while the inference also depends upon earlier premises establishing greatness and explaining why every nonmaximal degree remains arbitrary. Live burden: The case must identify a stable perfection standard and demonstrate that explanatory completeness concerning limits licenses maximality rather than only a nonarbitrary, potentially nonmaximal configuration of foundational attributes. Locked score: The strong or competent band recognizes clear structure, central relevance, and responsible conditional phrasing, while retaining substantial reservations about the incompletely defended transition from nonarbitrarily limited greatness to anything recognizably God-like.

con-holistic-theory-comparison.words: Fundamental limits may count against naturalism without independently establishing theism, because non-theistic and theistic theories still require holistic comparison across their total virtues.
con-holistic-theory-comparison.critique: Strongest feature: The reply precisely distinguishes a local theoretical cost from independent establishment of theism, granting the limits consideration genuine evidential relevance while locating its ultimate significance within holistic comparison. Principal limitation: Holism can become programmatic unless the competing virtues, their comparative weights, and the circumstances under which a foundational limit becomes decisive are specified beyond the general observation that theories differ overall. Live burden: The challenge must show how an independently attractive non-theistic package can rationally absorb unexplained limits, while still acknowledging that sufficiently serious arbitrariness could diminish that package’s comparative credibility. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, careful calibration, and direct contact with two central pro moves, tempered only by the unfinished task of conducting rather than merely requiring the proposed all-things-considered comparison.

pro-limits-as-comparative-theoretical-co.words: Arbitrary foundational limits can constitute a comparative theoretical cost even when that consideration neither demonstrates a worldview’s falsity nor rationally compels every evaluator.
pro-limits-as-comparative-theoretical-co.critique: Strongest feature: The reply productively accepts the holistic qualification and preserves a bounded evidential role for the limits argument, distinguishing comparative disadvantage from demonstration or compulsory worldview rejection. Principal limitation: Acknowledging a cost does not yet establish its magnitude, independence, or ability to survive tradeoffs against simplicity, explanatory breadth, and other virtues possessed by theories containing fundamental limits. Live burden: The pro case must provide principled criteria for measuring the arbitrariness cost and show circumstances in which an otherwise comparable theory avoiding that cost deserves rational preference. Locked score: The very strong band reflects unusually direct responsiveness, stable scope, explicit concessions, and well-calibrated inferential ambition, while recognizing that the move successfully relocates the argument into theory comparison without completing the comparative assessment needed to advance the broader motion.

pro-irrelevant-differences-demand-explan.words: Apparently irrelevant differences among possible foundational limits intensify the explanatory demand, supplying stronger reason to ask why one particular nonmaximal parameter obtains.
pro-irrelevant-differences-demand-explan.critique: Strongest feature: The move supplements general explanatory experience with a more focused intuition about irrelevant alternatives, thereby offering a recognizable source of pressure against selecting one unexplained foundational limit among comparable possibilities. Principal limitation: The relevant notion of irrelevance is indicated but not independently characterized, and the stronger evidential force attributed to it exceeds the compressed justification supplied for treating alternative parameters as equivalently eligible. Live burden: The argument must explain which modal alternatives are legitimate comparators, why their differences lack explanatory significance, and why this pattern persists when the candidate foundation has an essential nature. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects clear burden contact, recoverable reasoning, and valuable comparative pressure, balanced against partly unstable terminology, slightly overstated warrant, and only partial engagement with the broader holistic-comparison objection.

con-defeasible-explanatory-default.words: Experience supports seeking explanations only as a defeasible default, because independent theoretical evidence may rationally justify exceptions to an otherwise successful explanatory pattern.
con-defeasible-explanatory-default.critique: Strongest feature: The reply precisely distinguishes a defeasible explanatory presumption from an exceptionless metaphysical requirement, allowing theoretical considerations to warrant principled departures from experiential regularities. Principal limitation: It establishes warranted exceptions more convincingly than it supplies concrete, independently supported evidence identifying foundational limits as the relevant exception here. Live burden: The con case must specify when explanatory pressure is overridden, demonstrate why its proposed stopping point possesses exceptional status, and avoid treating the availability of a compatible theory as automatically defeating the default. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exact conceptual diagnosis, responsiveness to both central explanatory targets, and restrained calibration, with limited deduction because the supporting discussion remains indirect and vindicates no particular unexplained foundation.

con-rival-causal-principle-symmetry.words: Parallel inductive, abductive, intuitive, and relevant-difference support can motivate rival causal principles whose consequences conflict with traditional theistic creation from no material cause.
con-rival-causal-principle-symmetry.critique: Strongest feature: The symmetry challenge exposes an undercutting problem by arguing that parallel inductive, abductive, intuitive, and relevant-difference considerations can support rival causal principles conflicting with traditional theism. Principal limitation: Its force depends upon genuine evidential parity, but the move does not demonstrate that the material-causal rival and limits principle share comparable cases, modal scope, domain conditions, or explanatory motivation. Live burden: The con case must defend the parallel enough that distinctions involving causal type, domain, or background evidence cannot provide an inexpensive symmetry breaker. Locked score: The very strong band reflects lucid formulation, relevance, conditional calibration, and substantial pressure on the pro methodology, while leaving unresolved whether the alternative principle is genuinely co-supported rather than analogically suggestive.

pro-symmetry-breaker-burden.words: If competing principles receive equal support but yield incompatible consequences, the limits argument needs a symmetry breaker grounded in comparison of those principles and their evidence.
pro-symmetry-breaker-burden.critique: Strongest feature: The reply acknowledges the symmetry objection’s conditional force and correctly identifies comparison of rival principles and respective supports as the necessary next inquiry, avoiding premature victory. Principal limitation: It remains a burden acknowledgment, since no actual symmetry breaker is supplied and the limits principle stays undercut whenever evidential parity obtains. Live burden: The pro case must identify an asymmetry in domain, explanatory structure, modal force, or independent evidence, then demonstrate why that difference favors the limits principle without circularly presupposing its conclusion. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exemplary responsiveness, precision, candor, and diagnosis of the open inquiry, while recognizing that locating the decisive problem does not discharge the motion-level burden the problem creates.

con-axiologically-neutral-foundation.words: A mindless, impersonal foundation may be axiologically neutral, so fundamentality by itself does not provide the initial greatness required for ascent toward perfection.
con-axiologically-neutral-foundation.critique: Strongest feature: The objection isolates an indispensable bridge and supplies several intelligible impersonal candidates that appear neither positively valuable nor disvaluable, directly challenging the assumption that fundamentality entails greatness. Principal limitation: The neutrality judgment remains substantially intuitive, and describing candidate foundations as mindless does not alone establish that their causal, modal, explanatory, or generative features lack every value-conferring characteristic. Live burden: The con case must defend a criterion of intrinsic or derivative value under which these foundational candidates remain neutral while addressing proposals that productive power or value-grounding potential itself constitutes greatness. Locked score: The very strong band reflects central burden contact, careful possibility-level calibration, stable scope, and a forceful exposure of the greatness gap, tempered by the absence of a developed axiology independently confirming the proposed neutrality.

pro-mentality-and-value-producing-power.words: Independent arguments for foundational mentality and the original power to produce value offer two possible grounds for attributing some greatness to fundamental reality.
pro-mentality-and-value-producing-power.critique: Strongest feature: The reply acknowledges the neutrality gap and presents two routes toward foundational greatness: independent arguments for mentality and the original productive power underlying derivative value. Principal limitation: The mentality route is appended rather than established by the limits argument, while axiological importance of original value-producing power remains suggestive without precise explanation of why productive power inherits value. Live burden: The pro case must support mindedness or defend a value-conferring principle distinguishing active productive capacity from necessary enabling conditions that intuitively possess no value. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects direct engagement, useful diversification, explicit tentativeness, and relevance to the central bridge, constrained by underdefined terminology and incomplete warrant for either proposed foundation of greatness.

con-independent-mindedness-gap.words: The limits argument cannot independently establish theism because reaching a divine conclusion requires an additional premise, supported elsewhere, that the necessary foundation is minded.
con-independent-mindedness-gap.critique: Strongest feature: The reply sharply distinguishes what the limits argument itself establishes from what could follow only after appending independent support for mentality, exposing a decisive gap between perfected foundation and theism. Principal limitation: The objection establishes insufficiency of the argument alone but does not show that supplementation is illegitimate, unavailable, or unable to participate in a broader cumulative case. Live burden: The con side must preserve the distinction between criticizing standalone reach and denying combined evidential force, while the pro side must openly supply and defend the independent mindedness premise. Locked score: The exceptional very strong band reflects complete recoverability, precise conditional scope, excellent calibration, and direct motion-level responsiveness, with only the natural limitation that this diagnostic result underdetermines the eventual strength of a transparently supplemented argument.

pro-value-entailing-ground.words: A ground of a value-entailing property may itself entail value, since reality wholly lacking positive aspects could not acquire them without some positively significant potential.
pro-value-entailing-ground.critique: Strongest feature: The move offers a non-mental route from derivative value to foundational greatness and articulates an intuitively appealing thought that a wholly valueless reality cannot generate positive aspects without value-relevant potential. Principal limitation: The reasoning moves between grounding, dependence, potentiality, necessary enablement, and value-entailment without fixing their relationships, leaving open whether the conclusion concerns intrinsic value, instrumental value, or merely modal capacity. Live burden: The pro case must formulate a restricted transmission principle that excludes obvious counterexamples involving necessary conditions while explaining why the foundation’s productive relation is genuinely value-conferring. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects originality, direct contact with the neutrality objection, and appropriately candid uncertainty, offset by unstable inferential vocabulary, broad metaphysical reach, and insufficient defense of the transition from enabling value to possessing value.

con-necessary-condition-not-valuable.words: Necessary enablement of value does not imply being valuable, because mathematical necessities condition every valuable state without intuitively acquiring value themselves.
con-necessary-condition-not-valuable.critique: Strongest feature: The counterexample clearly separates being necessary for valuable states from being valuable and directly challenges any unrestricted inference from enablement or potentiality to axiological status. Principal limitation: Mathematical truths may be too passive or abstract to parallel an actively productive foundation, so the example defeats the broad principle more decisively than every narrower value-conferring proposal available to pro. Live burden: The con case must show that no relevant distinction involving agency, causal production, ownership of power, or constitutive grounding rescues the inference, while pro must formulate such a distinction precisely. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional clarity, direct responsiveness, intuitive force, and proportionate calibration, moderated only because the counterexample leaves room for a more discriminating principle tied specifically to active value-production rather than bare necessary conditioning.

con-necessary-nonmaximal-limit.words: A nonmaximal degree of foundational greatness may be nonarbitrary when metaphysical necessity or the foundation’s essential nature explains why that precise limitation obtains.
con-necessary-nonmaximal-limit.critique: Strongest feature: The reply directly contests the ascent from explained limits to maximality by offering two clear explanatory alternatives, metaphysical necessity and essential nature, compatible with genuine nonmaximal greatness. Principal limitation: Naming necessity or essence may relocate rather than resolve the explanatory concern unless those structures independently explain why this particular nonmaximal profile obtains instead of another possible profile. Live burden: The con case must show that essential explanation is substantively informative and nonarbitrary, while answering the proposal that a uniquely necessitating ground inherits the arbitrariness of what it selects. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precise alternatives, excellent response contact, appropriate possibility-level calibration, and central relevance, with remaining uncertainty confined to whether the proposed explanations genuinely terminate the arbitrariness regress rather than redescribe its location.

pro-strong-ground-inherits-arbitrariness.words: When a property uniquely and strongly necessitates an arbitrary property, the grounding property inherits that arbitrariness, preventing essential explanation from hiding arbitrary limits deeper in reality.
pro-strong-ground-inherits-arbitrariness.critique: Strongest feature: The reply narrows inheritance to uniquely necessitating grounding and thereby provides a focused answer to essentialist explanations that might otherwise conceal the same selective arbitrariness within a deeper property. Principal limitation: The inheritance principle is supported mainly through examples and intuition, leaving unresolved why explanatory necessitation transmits arbitrariness rather than transforming an unexplained selection into an explained essential consequence. Live burden: The pro case must justify transmission independently, specify the relevant uniqueness condition, and distinguish a genuinely arbitrary grounding property from a necessary nature whose internal structure supplies the missing difference. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precision, substantial originality, direct engagement, and disciplined restriction of scope, balanced against the remaining theoretical burden of establishing the principle rather than relying on its intuitive appeal.

con-arbitrariness-inheritance-scope.words: Broad arbitrariness inheritance threatens to make God inherit created limits, while restricting inheritance to grounding requires a principled explanation of why creative explanation behaves differently.
con-arbitrariness-inheritance-scope.critique: Strongest feature: The reply pressure-tests arbitrariness inheritance through a theologically salient creation case, exposing the dilemma between implausibly broad transmission and an apparently ad hoc grounding-only restriction. Principal limitation: The analogy does not establish that contingent creative explanation and strongly necessitating grounding are parallel, especially when reasons, agency, and indeterminacy mediate between creator and outcome. Live burden: The con case must identify the shared feature responsible for transmitting arbitrariness across both relations or show why restricting inheritance conflicts with grounding’s ordinary explanatory role. Locked score: The very strong band reflects direct contact, scope analysis, possibility framing, and a productive counterexample, with a modest limitation because the objection demands a principled distinction while leaving its success open.

pro-necessitating-grounding-creative-dis.words: Arbitrariness inheritance applies to tight necessitating grounding, not indeterministic creative explanation, allowing a free creator to explain contingent limits without inheriting their arbitrariness.
pro-necessitating-grounding-creative-dis.critique: Strongest feature: The reply identifies a concrete relevant difference between tight necessitating grounding and creative relations involving reasons, freedom, or indeterminacy, directly answering the proposed divine-creation counterexample. Principal limitation: The distinction is presented candidly as an intuitive difference rather than derived from a developed theory explaining exactly why necessitation transmits arbitrariness and indeterminacy blocks transmission. Live burden: The pro case must formalize the transmission condition and show that selective application follows from the metaphysics of these relations rather than from a desire to protect divine creation. Locked score: The very strong band reflects stable terminology, excellent responsiveness, explicit qualification, and an appropriately narrow claim, tempered by the unfinished justification of the differential intuition upon which the reply’s principled status ultimately depends.

con-divine-simplicity-model-cost.words: A deeper divine ground explaining tripersonality may introduce layers within God and conflict with traditional divine simplicity, creating a coherence cost for that model.
con-divine-simplicity-model-cost.critique: Strongest feature: The reply identifies a concrete model-level consequence of introducing deeper intradivine grounding and carefully limits the resulting compatibility concern to traditional accounts of divine simplicity. Principal limitation: The objection does not directly undermine the grounding-versus-creation distinction, and alternative, non-layered, or revisionary simplicity models may accommodate grounding language without the two-level structure described. Live burden: The con case must show that the relevant pro account truly requires ontological layers and that these layers conflict with the specific simplicity doctrine the argument needs rather than with one optional theological formulation. Locked score: The very strong band reflects careful calibration, clear recoverability, strong subsidiary relevance, and charitable scope, with its lower position within that band explained by indirect contact and the unresolved availability of coherent alternative divine models.

pro-triadic-godlike-perfection.words: The least-arbitrary foundation possesses maximal, or maximally compatible, power, positivity, and persistence across times and worlds, with timelessness offered as an alternative.
pro-triadic-godlike-perfection.critique: Strongest feature: The closing move explicitly names power, positivity, and persistence, qualifies persistence with temporal and timeless alternatives, and offers a gentler least-arbitrary formulation instead of insisting upon strict maximality. Principal limitation: The inference from reduced arbitrariness to maxima across three distinct dimensions remains compressed, and each attribute may involve different feasibility constraints, ordering problems, or reasons for a nonmaximal boundary. Live burden: The pro case must defend separate bridges from the explanatory principle to each perfection and clarify whether greatest compatible degrees suffice for the intended God-like conclusion. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects complete motion contact, clear attribute specification, and responsible qualification, while recognizing materially incomplete warrant for moving from an absence of arbitrary limits to maximal power, positivity, and persistence simultaneously.

strengths: Rasmussen presented a coherent explanatory program that begins neutrally with fundamental reality and treats arbitrary limits as a theoretical cost rather than an automatic refutation.
He responded exceptionally well to holistic-comparison pressure by conceding that the argument need not compel every evaluator and relocating its force within comparative theory choice.

His restricted inheritance principle directly engaged essentialist explanations, while the distinction between necessitating grounding and indeterministic creation answered the principal scope counterexample.
The final presentation clearly identified power, positivity, and persistence and preserved calibration through conditional language, temporal alternatives, and a gentler least-arbitrary formulation.

blunders.text: The central notion of arbitrariness remained partly underspecified, especially regarding which modal alternatives are relevantly equivalent and why foundational explanation cannot terminate at a nonmaximal parameter.
The route from a neutral foundation to greatness relied on appended mentality arguments or an insufficiently defended transmission from value-producing capacity to value.
Acknowledging the rival-principle symmetry burden was intellectually strong but left the needed symmetry breaker undelivered, limiting the argument’s independent comparative force.
The concluding transition from reduced arbitrariness to maximal power, positivity, and persistence compressed several distinct bridges whose feasibility and ordering conditions remained unresolved.

strengths: Schmid consistently distinguished a local theoretical disadvantage from independent establishment of theism, preserving nuance while placing the debate within holistic comparison.
He exposed the mindedness and axiological gaps with unusually direct challenges: a perfected foundation need not be personal, and necessary enablement of value need not itself be valuable.
The rival causal-principle objection created a serious symmetry burden by showing how parallel methodological support could generate consequences hostile to traditional theism.
His necessity and essence alternatives directly challenged the inference from explained limits to maximality, while his creation example productively tested arbitrariness inheritance.
The divine-simplicity concern was carefully scoped to a particular layered model and therefore raised a genuine theological coherence cost without overstating its reach.

blunders.text: The holistic-comparison response largely required a broader assessment without itself specifying decisive virtues, weights, or an independently attractive non-theistic package that absorbs foundational limits.
The claim that a mindless foundation may be axiologically neutral remained intuitive and did not fully exclude value-conferring causal, modal, or generative characteristics.
The rival-principle challenge depended on evidential parity that was suggested rather than fully demonstrated across causal domains and background assumptions.
The creation counterexample did not establish that indeterministic agency and strong necessitating grounding are sufficiently parallel for arbitrariness to transmit identically.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that arbitrary foundational parameters supply defeasible comparative evidence for a foundation whose positive capacities lack unexplained ceilings, although the conclusion remains conditional on independent support for mentality and value.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the pro route while narrowing its force and explicitly incorporating the independent-mindedness and value burdens.

premises.text: When multiple genuinely comparable foundational parameter values differ without explanatory relevance, selecting one finite value imposes a prima facie theoretical cost on the theory containing it.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the explanatory principle by limiting it to comparable alternatives and making its force expressly defeasible.

premises.text: A prima facie arbitrariness cost survives holistic comparison only when rival theories explain the same data with comparable simplicity and avoid introducing equal or greater unexplained structure elsewhere.

novelty.explanation: This develops the conceded comparative role into an explicit condition governing when the local cost remains evidentially important.

premises.text: A necessary essence explains a finite limitation only if its internal structure supplies a relevant difference; merely encoding the selected degree inside an essence does not automatically remove arbitrariness.

novelty.explanation: This narrows inheritance into a criterion for informative essential explanation instead of asserting unrestricted transmission.

premises.text: Positive value cannot be inferred from bare necessary enablement, but an agentive capacity that understands, selects, and intentionally realizes valuable possibilities may itself possess value-relevant excellence.

premises.text: If independent arguments support foundational agency, and no relevantly equivalent finite ceilings explain its power, goodness, or persistence, then theories assigning unexplained ceilings incur cumulative comparative costs.

novelty.explanation: This makes mentality an explicit independent condition and treats each perfection dimension separately rather than assuming a single automatic ascent.

conclusion.text: Therefore, conditional on independent evidence for foundational agency and sufficiently close rival theories, avoiding unexplained ceilings can favor a God-like foundation without independently demonstrating strict maximality or theism.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves the pro direction while limiting it to comparative support under explicit independent and theoretical conditions.

newArguments.title: Parameter Sensitivity Test
newArguments.text: A theory’s alleged foundational limit can be tested by varying only that parameter while holding its remaining explanatory structure fixed. If nearby values preserve every other theoretical virtue and the theory supplies no reason for the actual value, the limit produces a specific sensitivity cost rather than a vague preference for explanation. The comparison becomes stronger when a rival theory removes the free parameter without adding equivalent structure. This test does not prove that every finite quantity is arbitrary; it identifies the restricted circumstances in which arbitrariness has measurable comparative significance.

novelty.explanation: This is a new methodological test for isolating arbitrariness costs and is not presented in any locked participant move.

newArguments.title: Independent Convergence Across Attributes
newArguments.text: Instead of inferring three perfections from one unrestricted principle, evaluate power, positivity, and persistence through separate explanatory routes. Evidence for foundational agency bears most directly on power and value; modal independence bears on persistence; the limits principle then asks whether any remaining ceilings are independently motivated. Convergence matters because unrelated routes reaching compatible conclusions reduce dependence on a single controversial premise. The result would remain defeasible and might support only very great compatible degrees, but it would answer the objection that the triadic conclusion compresses distinct transitions into one step.

novelty.explanation: This independently introduces a convergence strategy that separates the three perfection dimensions before recombining their evidence.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that the limits principle supplies at most one defeasible theoretical consideration and cannot independently establish God-like perfection without justified comparison, mentality, axiology, and maximality bridges.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the strongest con objections into a proportionate underdetermination thesis rather than a denial of all evidential relevance.

premises.text: Explanatory success in ordinary cases supports a defeasible search policy, but extending that policy to the ultimate foundation requires domain-specific justification and remains sensitive to independent theoretical virtues.

novelty.explanation: This develops the default-principle objection by adding an explicit domain-transfer condition and comparative context.

premises.text: A foundational limit is not objectionably arbitrary merely because alternatives are conceivable; arbitrariness requires alternatives that are metaphysically available, explanatorily equivalent, and unsupported by the candidate’s nature.

novelty.explanation: This supplies a positive criterion for arbitrariness rather than relying only on the availability of necessary or essential explanations.

premises.text: Methodological support for a principle is weakened when parallel support generates incompatible principles, unless independently relevant differences explain why one induction or explanatory demand has privileged scope.

novelty.explanation: This refines the symmetry objection by stating what a successful symmetry breaker would have to establish.

premises.text: Fundamentality, causal productivity, and necessary enablement do not by themselves entail intrinsic value or mindedness; those conclusions require additional axiological and mental criteria supported independently.

novelty.explanation: This consolidates the greatness objections while distinguishing three properties that the pro route must not conflate.

premises.text: Even a fully explained foundational profile may be nonmaximal when its essential structure supplies relevant internal differences, so explanation of a limit does not generally entail elimination of that limit.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the essentialist response by requiring informative internal structure rather than treating necessity as automatically sufficient.

conclusion.text: Therefore, absent independently defended bridges and a completed holistic comparison, arbitrary-limit considerations may count against some theories but leave God-like perfection substantially underdetermined.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves the granted local cost while denying that it alone resolves the motion-level theoretical choice.

newArguments.title: Explanatory Budget Constraint
newArguments.text: Removing one unexplained finite ceiling may require adding modal principles, axiological structure, mentality, or internal divine relations. A fair comparison should count those additions within a common explanatory budget. If the supposedly limit-free theory replaces one visible parameter with several controversial necessities, it may not reduce total arbitrariness at all. This budget approach grants the pro side’s methodological concern while preventing selective attention to the rival’s limits. It also converts holistic comparison into a tractable question: which theory minimizes unsupported structure across its entire foundational profile, not merely within one favored attribute?

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new whole-theory accounting method for comparing removed limits against additional foundational commitments.

newArguments.title: Category Separation Argument
newArguments.text: Power, value, mentality, and persistence occupy different explanatory categories. Removing an arbitrary quantitative ceiling in one category cannot automatically establish membership, positivity, or maximality in another. A foundation might persist necessarily yet remain mindless, or possess immense productive capacity without intrinsic goodness. Consequently, each transition needs a category-specific bridge with independent evidence. This separation does not show that a God-like foundation is false; it shows why a single anti-arbitrariness norm cannot perform every required inferential task. The approach strengthens the underdetermination case while leaving room for separate arguments to support individual divine attributes.

novelty.explanation: This is a new categorical barrier argument that systematically separates the divine attributes and their required warrants.
